    # Batch Floyd sampling across all supervised positions. This reduces RNG
    # calls from approximately 32 * batch_size to 32 per optimizer step.
    # Exclusion-rank mapping remains per user and never allocates a catalog mask.
    row_specs = []
    available_parts = []
    offset = 0
    for row, user in enumerate(batch_users):
        count = int(eligible_np[row].sum())
        if count == 0:
            continue
        excluded = np.union1d(exclusions[user], pos_np[row, eligible_np[row]])
        excluded = excluded[(excluded >= 1) & (excluded <= model.itemnum)]
        available = model.itemnum - len(excluded)
        if available <= 0:
            eligible_np[row] = False
            continue
        row_specs.append((offset, offset + count, excluded))
        available_parts.append(np.full(count, available, dtype=np.int64))
        offset += count
    if not row_specs:
        return None

    available = np.concatenate(available_parts)
    counts = np.minimum(available, 32)
    ranks = np.zeros((offset, 32), dtype=np.int64)
    for column in range(32):
        active = column < counts
        upper = np.maximum(available - counts + column + 1, 1)
        draw = rng.integers(1, upper + 1, dtype=np.int64)
        if column:
            duplicate = (ranks[:, :column] == draw[:, None]).any(axis=1)
            draw = np.where(duplicate, upper, draw)
        ranks[:, column] = np.where(active, draw, 0)

    # Uniformly order each subset while leaving missing candidates at the end.
    # The one-negative controls take the first draw of the same 32-draw sample.
    keys = rng.random(ranks.shape)
    keys[ranks == 0] = np.inf
    order = np.argsort(keys, axis=1, kind="stable")
    ranks = np.take_along_axis(ranks, order, axis=1)[:, :NUM_NEGATIVES]
    negatives = np.zeros_like(ranks)
    for start, end, excluded in row_specs:
        thresholds = excluded - np.arange(len(excluded), dtype=np.int64)
        selected = ranks[start:end]
        mapped = selected + np.searchsorted(thresholds, selected, side="right")
        negatives[start:end] = np.where(selected != 0, mapped, 0)
